faqs.a: Anyone curious about AI and machine learning — students, developers, researchers, or hobbyists. Most events welcome beginners; flagship events like AI Day cater to all skill levels.

faqs.q: How do I register for events?
faqs.a: All event registrations are on Commudle. Join our community at commudle.com/communities/ml-bhopal to get notified when new events open.
Most workshops and meetups are free. Flagship events like AI Day may have a nominal fee (typically ₹299–₹599) to cover venue and logistics.

faqs.q: Can I speak, sponsor, or volunteer?
faqs.a: Yes! Email contact@mlbhopal.tech for speaking slots, sponsorship packages, or visit mlbhopal.tech/join to volunteer with the core team.

faqs.q: What is ML Bhopal's relationship with Google?
faqs.a: ML Bhopal started as TensorFlow User Group Bhopal (TFUG) and is backed by Google for Developers. We regularly host GDEs and run sessions on Google AI tools.

faqs.q: Is ML Bhopal only for Bhopal students?
faqs.a: While most events are in Bhopal, we welcome attendees from across Madhya Pradesh and Central India. Many participants travel from nearby cities for AI Day.

tabs.label: AI Day
tabs.title: AI Day Bhopal — Flagship Event
tabs.description: Central India's biggest AI builder conference: expert keynotes, parallel workshops, AI-Thon competition, expo partners, and guaranteed internship opportunities for top performers.

tabs.label: Meetups
